sequence_points.name: Landscape with Figures and River
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting figures near a river, rendered in soft, impressionistic brushstrokes with dominant blues, greens, and earth tones. The artwork is mounted on a wall within a museum setting.

sequence_points.name: Winter Landscape with Snow-Covered House
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting a snow-covered rural scene with a house nestled among trees, rendered in cool blue and white tones. The composition features a winding path through the snow, framed by bare trees under a pale sky.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with River and Trees
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting a river flowing through a field with trees in the background, rendered in muted greens, blues, and browns. The artwork is mounted on a museum wall with a dark frame.

sequence_points.name: Forest Scene with Darkened Trees
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented painting depicting a dense forest scene with dark, shadowy trees and muted earth tones. The composition emphasizes depth and texture, with the artwork mounted on a wall in a museum setting.
